D.comparison: 600-level students, who took histology before the pandemic

cells.quote: The 600-level class took histology during pre-pandemic times, and most 600-level students were unfamiliar with VM with even more students who had not used the technology (Figure 1). cells.quote: Student performance on the final summative practical exam was compared from one year prior to, and one year after the transition from microscopes to the VM. The 2007 pre-VM summative exam was administered to 165 students using traditional microscopes and had a mean score of 80.1 (SD = 5.38). The identical exam was administered in 2009 to 164 students using the VM and had a mean of 81.8 (SD = 11.9). There was no significant difference between the exam scores across the two modalities (t: -1.69, P-Value = 0.093, 95% CI = -3.73 < μ1-μ2 < 0.289).
cells.note: The comparison used different cohorts before and after implementation; the study reports no significant difference but no equivalence test or adequate-power analysis.
